scenes.text: Imagine standing in the middle of a burning hot desert, looking out at a completely empty horizon for hundreds of miles.
There is absolutely nothing around you except for one single, lonely acacia tree.
But in 1973, a drunk truck driver managed to drive straight across the vast, empty desert and crash directly into this single tree.
How do you even manage to hit the only obstacle for hundreds of miles? Tell me what you think in the comments and follow for more.
